name: Taavet Hinrikus
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026); Hurun Global U40 (2022); Hurun Unicorn founders (2019-2020)
forbes_bio: Taavet Hinrikus cofounded cross-border payments startup Transferwise in 2011 and took it public as Wise in July 2021 on the London Stock Exchange.
Wise offers low cost money transfers across 56 different currencies, allowing users to avoid big banking fees for moving money abroad.
Hinrikus and cofounder Kristo Käärmann are Estonia's first two billionaires. The pair met while working in London.
Käärmann and Hinrikus started Wise after having become "sick of losing money" to  banks in fees for sending money to Estonia.
Billionaires Peter Thiel and Richard Branson were early investors, followed by VC firm Andreessen Horowitz and money manager Baillie Gifford.

name: Wolfgang Egger
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2018-2022); Hurun Global (2021-2022)
forbes_bio: Wolfgang Egger is founder and CEO of publicly traded real estate company Patrizia AG.
Based in Augsburg, Germany, it employs around 800 people across 24 global offices and manages over $50 billion in real estate assets.
Egger started Patrizia in 1984 at the age of 19 and took it public in 2006.
He remains the largest shareholder, with just over 50%.
forbes_facts: Egger's Patrizia Foundation has provided educational support to nearly 240,000 children and young people through its KinderHaus facilities.
Patrizia owns the iconic Treptower, the tallest office building in Berlin, Germany.

name: Lee Hwa-kyung
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2017); Hurun Global (2014-2019)
forbes_bio: Lee Hwa-kyung is vice chairwoman of Orion Corp., one of the country's oldest and most popular confectionery businesses.
The company's most famous product is Choco Pie, which consists of a combination of biscuit, chocolate and marshmallow filling.
The bulk of Lee's wealth is derived from a stake in Orion Holdings, the group's listed holding company that also has interests in biopharma and entertainment.
Lee is the second daughter of Lee Yang-gu, founder of Dongyang, precursor to the group.
Her husband, Dam Chul-gon, is the chairman of Orion Corp. Her son, Dam Seo-won, serves as its vice president.
forbes_facts: In 2017, she was sentenced to eight months in prison with a two-year suspension for embezzling $356,000 through moving company-owned artworks to her home.
Dam Chul-gon was acquitted in 2016 after being charged with embezzlement in a separate case.
Lee also runs the group's entertainment business Showbox.

name: Yao Liangbo
forbes_bio: Yao is vice chairman of Oppein Home Group, one of China's largest makers of kitchen appliances and home furniture.
His brother Yao Liangsong is chairman of Oppein, who is also a member of the 2021 Forbes Billionaires List.
Oppein was founded in Guangzhou in 1994.

name: Eddy Kusnadi Sariaatmadja
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2015-2023); Hurun Global (2018-2026)
forbes_bio: Eddy Kusnadi Sariaatmadja cofounded Emtek in 1983 as the exclusive Compaq computer distributor in Indonesia; he has a majority stake.
Emtek currently controls three Indonesian TV channels, SCTV, Indosiar and O Channel.
His son Alvin Sariaatmadja is president director of Emtek, which is formally called Elang Mahkota Teknologi.
Emtek has collaborated with Alibaba's Ant Financial for Dana, a digital payment system in Indonesia.
In 2021 Emtek partnered up with Indonesia's conglemerate Salim Group to expand its digital businesses.
forbes_facts: In 2017, his media company Emtek hosted the Indonesian Diaspora Network Global event, featuring former U.S. President Barack Obama as a speaker.
Emtek also operates eight hospitals:seven EMC facilities of its own and one under the Omni Hospitals chain acquired from Sarana Meditama in 2020.

name: Evan Wallace
forbes_bio: Evan Wallace is cofounder and former chief technology officer of design software company Figma, which went public on the New York Stock Exchange in July 2025.
Figma listed its shares at a fully diluted valuation (including outstanding equity awards) of nearly $20 billion. Its stock price more than tripled on its first trading day.
Figma had previously agreed to be acquired by Adobe for $20 billion in September 2022, but the deal was scrapped in December 2023 over regulatory concerns.
Wallace launched Figma in 2012 with Brown University classmate Dylan Field. Wallace left the company in 2021 but remains the company's second largest individual shareholder after Field.
Wallace donated a third of his Figma stock to the nonprofit Marin Community Foundation a month before Figma went public. The gift was worth nearly $440 million based on Figma's IPO listing price.

name: Guan Yihong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2021-2023); Hurun Global (2020-2023); Hurun China (2020-2023)
forbes_bio: GuanYihong chairs Jiumaojiu International, one of China's largest restaurant chains.
GuanYihong started his first noodle restaurant in China's Hainan Province in 1995 and found Jiumaojiua decade later.
He holds a bachelor's degree in business management from Tianjin Institute of Textile Science and Technology.
Jiumaojiu listed at the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2020.
